component.name: Cosmic Windows Swapper
component.summary: Windows/KDE-style Super+Tab window switcher for COSMIC

description.p: A macOS-style horizontal app switcher for the COSMIC desktop. Press Super+Tab to cycle through open windows with a smooth overlay — without letting go of Super. The panel applet lets you pick from Dark, Light, Frosted, and Midnight themes.
On first use, click "Enable Super+Tab" in the panel applet to register the keyboard shortcut automatically. No terminal required.

screenshot.caption: Super+Tab overlay — horizontal icon strip with selected app highlighted
Panel applet — theme picker and shortcut toggle

description.p: New Windows/KDE-style layout: Super+Tab now shows a grid of live window previews with titles. The previous icon strip is still available as the Icons layout.
The panel applet can now switch layouts, pick a preview size, and toggle window titles, and it writes those settings to the same config file the overlay reads.
The project is renamed to CosmicWindowsSwapper: app id, binary names, desktop entry, and icon all change, and an existing config and shortcut binding are migrated on first launch.
Fixes the one-line installer, which downloaded a malformed URL and failed for everyone.
Enabling or disabling the Super+Tab shortcut now rewrites COSMIC's shortcut config safely, instead of leaving a file COSMIC can't parse.
Adds a switch scope setting: cycle windows from all workspaces, or only those on the current monitor.
Initial release — Super+Tab overlay switcher with Dark, Light, Frosted, and Midnight themes.
